 Live Results: Georgia Senate midterm election
 Politics 
 Nov 3, 2026 5:00 AM EST
 WATCH LIVE: Election night 2026 PBS News special coverage 
 Georgia Sen. Jon Ossoff, elected in a 2021 runoff, is the only Democratic senator seeking reelection in a state that President Donald Trump won in 2024.
 Stand with free and independent journalism. Join Press Pass from PBS News 
 His Republican challenger, Rep. Mike Collins, beat Gov. Brian Kemp's preferred candidate, Derek Dooley, in a June runoff after Trump endorsed him. Collins has made immigration and border security his central issue. 
 -- Matt Loffman
